name: komdosh-dev-kotlin-doc-revealer
description: Smart source-documentation discovery for internal classes, project architecture, frameworks, libraries, and open-source. Adds /doc-reveal <symbol|topic|library>[#anchor] backed by the doc-revealer agent and the reveal-source-docs skill. Targets the cheapest source first — in-repo KDoc/Javadoc + /docs, then ~/.claude/docs-cache/, then MCP (context7, ref-context, codebase-memory), then canonical web URLs (docs.spring.io / javadoc.io / kotlinlang.org / GitHub README+wiki) via WebFetch with WebSearch fallback, then pre-indexed JAR listings under ~/.claude/jar-cache/listings/. JAR decompilation is the explicit last resort, only when every prior source fails. Caches resolved snippets and URL maps to avoid repeating expensive fetches. Read-only beyond the docs-cache. Requires komdosh-dev-spring-core.
